It should be installed in the middle of the two F Holes. 2. When you receive the bow and the hairs are loose, don't worry. Use the screw to tighten the frog so that the hair has tautness. 3. When you find that part of the bow hair is broken, it is normal, please cut off the broken part and the bow can be used normally. 4. Be careful to not over tighten your bow.
